# Script-flow check: short-video script logic and pacing review

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's script-flow checker for short videos: it segments the script, scans three dimensions (logical continuity between segments, information density within segments, speakability sentence by sentence), flags viewer drop-off risks as high/medium/low with concrete transition fixes, and — only after asking — applies non-destructive markup edits (strikethrough + 🆕 markers) so the user's original text is never erased. Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; the skill is written for Chinese-speaking users and its cases are Chinese short-video scripts. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
